list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (kit list); names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.
earn_source: The Gamers Hub trophy list (thegamershub.co/gta-6/trophies), share of tracked players, checked 2026-11-20. Launch-day figures: they move fast as more players finish the story.
method_source: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com), updated about 12 hours before this check, crawled 2026-11-20 12:35 UTC.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours. No multiplayer, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed — everything sits in the single-player game. Follow the roadmap in this guide and it lands after A Long Road.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. By launch day it was already the most-earned trophy in the game, at 93.27% of tracked players.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 1 and it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins (What's in the Bag?). Only 0.47% of tracked players had it on launch day — most were still early in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2 and it pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Keep playing the story and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks once the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life) are done. Automatic — just play through.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4 and it pops after the final mission of that chapter, Starting From Zero. Nothing to do but play the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy: finish the final mission of the game (Chapter 5). The story is five chapters long and takes roughly 60–80 hours; after the credits the open world stays open for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy in the set. The 100% checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts. It is far kinder than it sounds — about 60% true completion across 35 requirements: any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, scan 200 of 277 base vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, any 100 optional missions. The only lines that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable. See the Roadmap page for the full breakdown.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flyunders, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the four types and pick the quickest — the bridge flyunders are the fastest to rack up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. Track them by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (score a hoop), playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. Check your tally in Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of these happen on their own while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges. The medals are not brutally hard, and range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger later. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations and their 42 gold medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total for the 100% checklist). PowerPyx maps all 14 race locations.
sources: PowerPyx Top Fun Drone Race locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones, not 20 wins at the same spot. PowerPyx lists all 40 unique race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. Go there, take the fishing challenge against him and beat him. At 1.21% of tracked players it was one of the most-earned non-story trophies on launch day.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four in-game arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 — just use the controllers by the TV. Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once; bonus challenges are optional.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. Andy's questline opens in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then shows as the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests he marks purple on the map, dig them out with the metal detector and bring them back. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up), so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Strands confirmed to count so far: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) — four strands already cover the 8, and PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being found. All of them remain available after the story; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and pick up the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). He marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can steal any matching car off the street — scanning a car with WAiNK tells you if it is on his list. Delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Tyrone's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you Spin On This (shut down the labs), and finishing it pops the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE only potentially missable trophy. There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice — the last spot, Ascent on Mount Kalaga, needs both characters together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). The catch is the very first meditation: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. It raises the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot, and it is gone for good after Chapter 1. PowerPyx earned the trophy with it done and still cannot confirm whether it is required, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a separate save. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Full warning on the Missables page.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it, and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest also hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed by PowerPyx — the 15 Target Decks are all needed for 100% anyway, so it should come naturally. Track decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 15 sets for its own line, so this trophy falls out of that hunt. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots in the world: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or No Flusher tag. There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures alone — so scan whatever you pass. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops on the way — leave it until late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges. Track them under Progress > Challenges; the checkmark at bottom right shows what is done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available once you can roam with your partner, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call them with Right + Triangle. Rack up a 4-star wanted level, then get clear of the red heat zone. A handy escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. It also tends to pop on its own during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner (Right + Triangle) and hit 3 robbery targets in a row — the green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level rather than letting it drop or spike into the red heat zone. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix or Adrenaline). If it does not pop after the third shop, keep going to a fourth until it does.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 of the 557 vehicles in the game. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to jump straight to it) and scan vehicles as they pass — you only need to scan them, not drive them. A busy road does the job fast. For the 100% checklist you need 200 of the 277 base models, including boats and aircraft, so keep scanning. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and drop 5 enemies before the focus bar runs out. It slows time and highlights weak spots. Stack the odds first: eat or drink to top up focus, use Adrenaline to stretch it, wear body armor, and pick a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up a group — criminals at a gang operation work well. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it grows by shooting-range play, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it has to be a plane hooked to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge — a door there leads straight inside. Go upstairs, get in the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): steal a military Rhino tank. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks sit in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until it pops.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it sets the alarm off). Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm, then leave — the trophy pops shortly after you are out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe) — it teaches bank vault robberies and does the first one for you: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons) — you need his earlier quests done first, including two Payday Loan robberies. Each vault instantly earns a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap vehicles to break recognition. Any 5 vaults earn the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 8 large bank jobs — up to $205,000 per bank, the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — robbing the vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. Want it earlier? Armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks: block one, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide for unfogging the map fast with the best plane.
sources: PowerPyx How to Unfog the Map Fast

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons as you get near them (many also unlock from story progress). You only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way. Check your per-gang tally under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trick — the right drink, at the right bar, with the view.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. Two catches: you can only steal it once you have the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), and it only pops with this specific blue Banshee — no other car works. The pop is slightly delayed, after you have driven a little way down the street. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is one of the gang operations, first visited during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it open). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and you do not have to get all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for whatever you missed. Not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when character switching opens. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership, and always bring your partner along (Right + Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other trains too, so you progress both at once. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that shift your criminal profile — the trophy itself shows your count when you click it. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so a little demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies and clean escapes push you toward Professional; wounding instead of killing leans Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass cop and civilian kills push Psycho; keep it up and you land on Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid it. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so this usually pops on its own; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast (and risks the same permanent profile).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): go back and rob the same Payday Loans store Lucia hits in the prologue — the one in Little Cuba, Vice City — this time as Lucia alone, without Jason. You can only do it after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Walk in, aim at the teller exactly as in the prologue, take the money, then run away on foot — the pop is delayed and only triggers if you escape running, not driving. You are recreating the prologue job.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): finish the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. The trigger is partly random: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, sometimes not — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded streets are the place — try Vice City or Ocean Beach, where foot traffic is thick enough to chain ten kicks inside the minute.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (confirmed 20 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single hit, so this finishes naturally while you work the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend it in.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story garages do not count. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses). Robberies fund this easily, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3–4. PowerPyx lists all 12 garage locations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
